name: 問者的素衣
caption: 剪刀沒有用過。她那晚沒有問完。
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one close-up evidence photograph for a Taiwanese folk-horror game, landscape3:2. Meticulously realistic physical object, tactile worn materials, shallow but sufficient depth of field with key clues all in focus, practical flashlight and muted amber spill, damp abandoned Taiwanese mountain temple in2026, grounded documentary photography. Suspense from concrete evidence rather than monsters. One coherent photograph, not collage or split panels. No captions, no UI, no watermark, no extraneous lettering. Keep important object well exposed and complete in frame. Subject: An unbleached ivory cotton button-front blouse folded on an old wooden crate. Two tightly gathered fist-shaped wrinkled bunches in CHEST fabric as if held by two hands, but no hands present. LEFT sleeve cuff has a thin red cord tied with THREE small knots, end burnt into a tiny black bead. Tiny unused shiny dressmaking scissors pinned at lapel. Loose cotton weave, humidity, ash flecks. No blood, no body, no graphic harm. CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: This must be a frightening NIGHT-TIME location photograph, NOT a clean studio product shot or daytime illustration. Background falls into deep near-black darkness, only a narrow off-camera FLASHLIGHT beam with faint dying candle spill reveals the evidence. Surroundings ancient, neglected, water-damaged, cracked wood, mold, cobwebs, grime, realistic soot. Low-key cold desaturated green-black shadows, dirty muted amber highlights. Claustrophobic, unsettling horror-film realism, fine believable materials. No sunshine, bright window, white studio backdrop, glossy showroom, excessive fog hiding clues, or comic illustration. Keep clue readable in the flashlight pool; do not underexpose the key object.
